# Grid

## Summary
Catalog shared grid component: renders the results of a card query as a
grid with view switching — the browsing surface the catalog app itself is
built on. Lives in the catalog realm at `components/grid` (named export
`CardsGrid`; a sibling copy powers `catalog-app/components/grid`).

## API
- `@query` — card Query; `@realms` — realm URLs to search
- `@selectedView` — grid presentation variant
- `@context` — CardContext for live queries and card opening

## Usage
```gts
import { CardsGrid } from 'https://realms-staging.stack.cards/catalog/components/grid';

<CardsGrid @query={{this.query}} @realms={{this.realms}}
  @selectedView='grid' @context={{@context}} />
```
For a zero-config realm index card, see the base Cards Grid spec — this
component is the lower-level building block.
